content:
Verizon Communications (VZ) shares have lost 6.8%, dividends included , since September 18, 2026. The S&P 500 gained 0.6% over the same period. Shareholders are now waiting on a promise from July, when management raised its 2026 guidance and said the second half of the year would be stronger than the first. The dates most likely to move Verizon stock over the next six months are outlined below, starting with the company’s third-quarter report.

Verizon’s Third-Quarter Report On October 26

Verizon is expected to report its fiscal Q3 2026 results before the market opens on or around October 26, 2026. The release delivers the first quarter of results since management promised faster growth. On the July 24 call, management guided service revenue from mobile and broadband customers to grow close to 3% from a year earlier in the third quarter. That service revenue came to $23.4 billion in fiscal Q2 2026, representing about two thirds of total Verizon revenue. When the company reports on October 26, service revenue growth against that guide will be the number to watch.

New AI Infrastructure Deals Verizon Plans To Announce

During the same July 24 call, management said it expected to announce more AI infrastructure deals by the end of 2026, which together would be worth multiple billions of dollars in revenue over several years. They would join an agreement with Google, valued at over $1 billion, to use Verizon’s dark fiber to connect Google’s data centers. Management expects the AI work to add noticeably to revenue growth starting in 2027, and Verizon is also retrofitting many of its central offices into data centers for inference edge computing. The company earns most of its money from phone and home internet plans. AI deals of that size would be a new source of revenue. You will want to see whether Verizon announces those deals by the end of 2026, and the revenue it puts on them.

Management has said it will talk about 2027 during its fiscal Q4 2026 report, which is expected on or around January 28, 2027. The company has already said it sees 2027 being better than 2026, and it guided service revenue to grow about 4% from a year earlier in the fourth quarter. That same report will show how 2026 ended against the raised guidance, including free cash flow growth of 9% to 10%. The measure to watch in January is what Verizon says about 2027 service revenue growth.

Could You Hold Verizon Stock Through Another Sharp Fall?

Report dates have moved Verizon stock sharply before. Shares rose 12.1% around the January 30, 2026 call. The past few weeks show what a sharp move the other way feels like. In 18 trading sessions, Verizon stock fell 17.8%, dividends included, from its close on September 15, 2026 to its close on October 9, 2026. The worst single session in that fall, October 8 to October 9, took 8.7% off the value of the shares. If a repeat of that fall would not force you to sell, your Verizon position is one you could keep through both reports.

Not necessarily on Verizon Communications alone, if your goal is long-term wealth. Wealth is built by owning the companies that keep outperforming, the leaders of their industries, wherever they are. Here are two companies from Verizon Communications’ own industry that have beaten it. Over the five years to October 2026, AT&T stock rose 58% and IDT stock rose 71%, while Verizon Communications stock rose 16.1%.

chineseTitle: 对 Verizon 股票最重要的日期
chineseSummary: 自 2026 年 9 月 18 日以来，Verizon Communications (VZ) 股价已下跌 6.8%（包括股息）。同期标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.6%。股东们现在正在等待 7 月份的承诺，当时管理层提高了 2026 年的指导方针，并表示下半年将强于上半年。下面列出了未来六个月最有可能影响 Verizon 股票走势的日期，从该公司第三季度报告开始。
chineseContent:
自 2026 年 9 月 18 日以来，Verizon Communications (VZ) 股价已下跌 6.8%（包括股息）。标准普尔 500 指数同期上涨 0.6%。股东们现在正在等待 7 月份的承诺，当时管理层提高了 2026 年的指导方针，并表示下半年将强于上半年。下面列出了未来六个月最有可能影响 Verizon 股票走势的日期，从该公司第三季度报告开始。

Verizon 10 月 26 日发布第三季度报告

Verizon 预计将在 2026 年 10 月 26 日左右开市前公布 2026 年第三季度财报。该新闻稿发布了自管理层承诺更快增长以来的第一季度业绩。在 7 月 24 日的电话会议上，管理层指导第三季度来自移动和宽带客户的服务收入同比增长近 3%。 2026 财年第二季度，该服务收入达到 234 亿美元，约占 Verizon 总收入的三分之二。当该公司 10 月 26 日发布报告时，该指南的服务收入增长将是值得关注的数字。

Verizon 计划宣布的新人工智能基础设施交易

在 7 月 24 日的同一次电话会议上，管理层表示，预计到 2026 年底将宣布更多人工智能基础设施交易，这些交易在未来几年内将带来数十亿美元的收入。他们将加入与谷歌达成的价值超过 10 亿美元的协议，使用 Verizon 的暗光纤连接谷歌的数据中心。管理层预计，从 2027 年开始，人工智能工作将显着促进收入增长，Verizon 还将其许多中央办公室改造为数据中心，以进行推理边缘计算。该公司的大部分收入来自电话和家庭互联网计划。如此规模的人工智能交易将成为新的收入来源。您将想知道 Verizon 是否会在 2026 年底之前宣布这些交易，以及它们带来的收入。

管理层表示，将在 2026 年第四季度财报中讨论 2027 年，预计该报告将于 2027 年 1 月 28 日左右发布。该公司已表示，预计 2027 年将好于 2026 年，并指导第四季度服务收入同比增长约 4%。同一份报告还将显示 2026 年的收官情况与提高的指引相比，包括自由现金流增长 9% 至 10%。 1 月份值得关注的指标是 Verizon 所说的 2027 年服务收入增长。

你能持有 Verizon 股票度过另一次大幅下跌吗？

报告日期之前曾使 Verizon 股价大幅波动。在 2026 年 1 月 30 日的电话会议前后，该股上涨了 12.1%。过去几周的情况表明，另一种方式的急剧转变是一种什么样的感觉。从 2026 年 9 月 15 日收盘到 2026 年 10 月 9 日收盘，Verizon 股票在 18 个交易日内下跌了 17.8%（包括股息）。10 月 8 日至 10 月 9 日是该年秋季最糟糕的一个交易日，股价下跌了 8.7%。如果重蹈覆辙不会迫使你出售，那么你可以在两份报告中保留你在 Verizon 的立场。

如果您的目标是长期财富，则不一定仅限于 Verizon Communications。财富是通过拥有持续表现优异的公司、行业的领导者而积累的，无论他们身在何处。以下是 Verizon Communications 所在行业的两家击败它的公司。截至 2026 年 10 月的五年间，AT&T 股票上涨 58%，IDT 股票上涨 71%，而 Verizon Communications 股票上涨 16.1%。
